title: Vesper and the Portrait
author: Q. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Paloma Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
